lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is the joint work session Wednesday where the Planning Commission and BOCC sit down together to work through proposed Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal operations — the kind of shaping-the-rules session that doesn't get a lot of attention but sets the table for decisions that will. Wednesday evening the commissioners also make a rare trip to Norwood to consider a Planning Commission appointment and hear Placerville Fire Survey results, while the Ecology Commission digs into the county's Climate Action Plan with a focus on transportation and land use.

notable.stake: Commissioners appoint Planning Commission alternate and review Placerville Fire Survey results.
Climate Action Plan review covers transportation and land use — policies that affect how locals move around.
Proposed Land Use Code changes to forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal rules are on the table.
